known_secrets.text: I have seen older stone edges beneath irrigation channels that do not match modern farming layouts.
Tarala once showed me a path in the forest that leads uphill toward the palace-monument terraces.
That path feels 'older' than the farm system.
I once overheard Marisha talking about hidden food reserves.
She stopped speaking when she noticed me.
Chapala once told me he thinks the palace-monument complex has 'closed doors that were meant to open.'
I do not know what he meant, but I remember it.
Senaka keeps notebooks of stories people tell her.
She said no two people remember the same past.
